text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with postmenopausal bleeding and an adnexal mass; to understand the severity of this, how old are you and when did the bleeding first start?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. No previous history of similar symptoms. She has no history of serious illness and takes no medications regularly.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Hyperplasia (possibly atypical) or Endometrial Carcinoma.

I have noted you are 65 with two months of intermittent bleeding. Given the presence of an adnexal mass, I need to rule out malignancy in both the endometrium and the ovary. REQUEST TEST: Transvaginal Ultrasound to measure endometrial thickness and characterize the adnexal mass. REQUEST TEST: CA-125 blood level. REQUEST TEST: Endometrial Biopsy.
